Stone changes it only by decision; each change is logged in career/2014/00_Team_Operations/Team/Depth_Chart/depth_chart.md and copied here in the same commit.
effective: August 30, 2014, after Caldwell's reduction to 53 (4 p.m. ET); the defensive-back order set for Week 2 on September 13, 2014 and game_day_inactives re-set for Week 3 on September 20, 2014
sources: The August 28 personnel packet's season depth chart baseline (Regular-season Week 1.md: Adams X, Thielen H, Hawkins Z; Lewis, Kelce, Jensen; Monroe, Bitonio, Brewster, Turner, Johnson; Kreiter snapping; Hawkins returning kicks and punts with Hurns the second punt returner; Nicks back to X and Adams to Z only after medical clearance and a full practice week); the frozen August 27 Atlanta chart (Preseason_Games/Game_04/depth_chart.json) for every other order; the current roster for control and availability; the August 30 reduction (Roster_Decisions/final_roster_cuts.md) for the 53.
rule: Order within each kernel position group, first = starter, as the kernel reads it. The packet's baseline sets the starting eleven on offense, the snapper and the returners; the Atlanta chart's order is carried for everyone else, minus the players who left on August 30. A player out under a medical instruction is listed last in his group while out and is on the inactive list (Nicks stays listed last after his September 20 clearance until a full practice week, Stone's condition; Hoskins, cleared September 16, keeps the fourth tight-end place); a player on reserve/injured is off the chart; his return to the order is Stone's decision on clearance under the packet's condition. The roles field carries the kernel roles (passer, placekicker, punt, kick_return, punt_return); Hurns is the second punt returner by Stone's instruction and is not given the kernel role, which the kernel reads as the first returner.

captains.structure: Six captains, three on offense (quarterback, offensive line, skill group) and three on defense (defensive line, linebackers, secondary), named by Stone with no player vote

game_day_inactives.note: Seven of the 53 are inactive for Week 3 against Indianapolis (46 dress; rules library R4), set by Stone on September 20, 2014 after the Indianapolis preparation. No player on the 53 is out by medical instruction: Stanford and Johnson cleared September 19 and 17, Hoskins September 16 and Nicks September 20, each on his projected date. Five are set by Stone's standing rule for the healthy inactives, the deepest healthy reserve on the chart in each of the five largest healthy position groups, never below a legal game-day unit, re-set each week; at September 20 those groups are the defensive backs (10: Alan Ball, listed last), the offensive line (9: Corey Linsley), the defensive line (8: Kasim Edebali), the linebackers (7: Todd Davis) and the receivers (6: Hakeem Nicks, listed last under Stone's full-practice-week condition after a Saturday clearance with no practice week). Gator Hoskins and Taylor Gabriel are carried from the Week 2 list under the roster-decision rule that a week without a new inactive list reuses the last one, the standing rule naming only five when no player is out by instruction; whether Hoskins's practice week should displace a carried place is a Stone decision the packet did not cover, recorded as open in the Week 3 record. Stanford, cleared September 19, is active with his chart place unchanged; Johnson starts at right tackle after the September 18 retest. Mike Harris and Dwight Lowery are on reserve/injured from September 8 and are not on the chart. The four reserve/injured players and the seven practice-squad players are not on the 53 and cannot appear here.
